paper_title: Probing a diffuse flux of axion-like particles from galactic supernovae with neutrino water Cherenkov detectors
coupling_convention: g_ap, dimensionless ALP-proton coupling, exactly as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper derives new observed constraints from Super-Kamiokande (phases I-IV, exposure 22.5 x 5823 kton days) on the ALP-proton coupling via a p -> p gamma scattering of a diffuse galactic supernova ALP flux. The excluded region is a BAND: g_ap between ~2e-5 and ~2e-4 for m_a = 1-70 MeV (couplings above ~2e-4 are not excluded because ALPs are trapped in the proto-NS and never reach Earth). Data points encode the LOWER boundary (~2e-5) of the excluded band spanning 1-70 MeV; the upper edge is ~2e-4. No numerical table provided; values taken from abstract/text describing Fig. 4. 95% C.L. stated in Appendix B. This is NOT a dark-matter haloscope search (astrophysical SN flux), so no local DM density assumed. A separate HK projection (~1e-5, masses <= 50 MeV) exists but the primary result is the observed SK exclusion, so is_projection=false.
